options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path for the investigations endpoint. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: disposition
options.description: The disposition of the investigation. Can be updated on existing investigations.

options.name: finding_ids
options.description: List of finding IDs (event_ids) to attach to the investigation. When updating, findings are added to the investigation via a separate API call. Finding IDs can only be added, removal is not supported.

options.name: investigation_ref_id
options.description: Reference ID of an existing investigation. If provided, the module will update the existing investigation. If not provided, a new investigation is created. When updating, all fields except C(name) can be modified.

options.name: investigation_type
options.description: The type of the investigation. If not specified, the default investigation type is used. Can be updated on existing investigations.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the investigation. Required when creating a new investigation (without C(investigation_ref_id)). Cannot be updated after creation. Note that names are not unique - multiple investigations can have the same name.

options.name: owner
options.description: The owner of the investigation. Use C(admin) for the administrator user. Use C(unassigned) to leave the investigation unassigned. Can be updated on existing investigations.

options.name: sensitivity
options.description: The sensitivity of the investigation. Can be updated on existing investigations.

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the investigation. Can be updated on existing investigations.

options.name: urgency
options.description: The urgency of the investigation. Can be updated on existing investigations.
